design_system_overview.theme: Dark Luxe Gold ('gold-night' #0a0907 background) for Admin Chrome & Dual-Mode for Login (~420px variant)
design_system_overview.aesthetic_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & PRECISION (High-End Salon & Restaurant Enterprise SaaS)
design_system_overview.primary_objective: Replace flat JPG/PNG logo banner with a living, high-precision HTML/CSS brand lockup featuring CSS gold light-sweep shimmer, twinkling stars around ring emblem, breathing radial glow, and ultra-crisp typography.

sparkle_twinkle.name: sparkle-twinkle
sparkle_twinkle.css: @keyframes sparkle-twinkle { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.3) rotate(0deg); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.15) rotate(45deg); } }

emblem_breathe.name: emblem-breath
emblem_breathe.css: @keyframes emblem-breath { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 14px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35)); } 50% { transform: scale(1.03); filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 24px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.65)); } }

accessibility_and_reduced_motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Disable gold-sweep, sparkle-twinkle, and emblem-breath animations. Set wordmark fill to static #D4AF37.
accessibility_and_reduced_motion.contrast_compliance: All subtitle text rendered at 8.5px with tracking 0.22em on dark #0a0907 background meets APCA & WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio.

layouts.sidebar: Flex col centered, 256px max width, zero horizontal overflow, optical vertical gap of 8px between emblem and wordmark
layouts.login: Flex col centered, 420px max width, enhanced scale

grids.mode: MODE B: High Density Admin Sidebar Header

motion.interactive_elements: Hover state intensifies gold glow and speeds up shimmer sweep

3d libraries.status: Not required for lockup; pure hardware-accelerated CSS keyframe animations used for 60fps performance without layout shifts

image urls.description: Gold ring emblem with MS initials and star accent

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace flat img '/assets/brand/ms-suite-banner.png' in MasterBrand.jsx (SidebarMiracurlLogo) with living HTML/CSS structure.
Use Playfair Display for 'MIRACURL SUITE' text with CSS gold gradient text fill and gold-sweep animation.
Add 3 absolute positioned twinkling stars around the ms-logo-ring.png image with staggered keyframe delays.
Add 'SMART SALON & RESTAURANT MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE' in Outfit 8.5px uppercase tracking-[0.22em].
Add 'Manage. Automate. Grow.' in Caveat 14px script below.
Ensure data-testid='sidebar-miracurl-logo-block' is attached to the parent container.
Update BrandMark.jsx to match the same CSS lockup for login/standalone uses.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts without intentional spacing and hierarchy.
Always set explicit data-testid attributes on key components.
Use specific transition properties instead of 'transition: all'.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion in CSS animation declarations.
Do not use dark colors as flat gradients, keep dark backgrounds rich with tinted noise/glint.
